description:
Responsibilities:  
 Must work with designers in integrating designs and templates with front end logic 
 Develop and maintain singe page applications 
 Test and refine RESTful APIs 
 Stay up – to – date on the latest front end technologies 
 Contribute to design and technology decisions 
 Establish and promote design guidelines, best practices and standards 
 Conduct user research and evaluate user feedback 
 Document his/her codebase 
 

 Required Experience:  
 BS or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Interactive Design or related field 
 3+ years of experience in modern front end languages such as JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3. 
 Working understanding of JavaScript framework such as Angular, Ember or React 
 Experience unit testing JavaScript 
 Experience calling your own or external RESTful APIs such as Google Maps or Spotify APIs. 
 Experience Debugging CSS layout issues 
 Experience with jQuery 
 Experience with building responsive websites that create a positive user experience 
 Must be up to date with latest UI trends, techniques and technologies 
 Involvement with CommonJS and packaging systems such as bowserify or webpack 
 Experience with Git and Github source control
 


 JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3,RESTful API 

 Multiple Openings for GC/Citizen
